row.title: Protected paths of a split landing travel in one slice
row.body: The round-3 landing changed three protected paths together (the requirement-id check, the protected-path gate and the record check). A stack that spread them over several slices would need a Protected-change line on each pull request and would gate each partial guard alone; they were kept in the first slice of the stack with the tests that read them (test_spec_ids, test_protected_paths, test_selfhost) and the workflow budget file those tests and the lint read, so one Protected-change line covers them and every later slice touches no protected path.
